Czech Republic — Starter Asset Profiles

Ten ready-made asset profiles for a Czech company, one per depreciable asset account of the chart, each posting to its own accumulated-depreciation account and to 551.

Version19.0.1.0.0
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresaccount_asset_tax_oca, l10n_cz

What it is for

In the Community asset register (OCA account_asset_management) every asset needs an asset profile: it says which accounts the depreciation posts to and over how long the asset is depreciated. A new Czech company has all the asset accounts in its chart but no profile, so the first asset — created by hand or imported — has nothing to point to.

This module gives each Czech company ten starter profiles, one for every depreciable asset account of the Czech chart of accounts. They cover accounting depreciation (účetní odpisy) only. Tax depreciation (daňové odpisy) follows the statutory depreciation groups and is handled separately by account_asset_tax, which this module installs with it; the Czech groups themselves come from l10n_cz_account_asset_tax.

Legal background

Under § 28 odst. 6 of the Accounting Act the company must draw up its own depreciation plan (odpisový plán) and depreciate an asset in the course of its use, up to its carrying value. The implementing vyhláška č. 500/2002 Sb. adds:

  • § 56 odst. 2: where the useful life of goodwill or of development results cannot be estimated, the company chooses a period of 60 to 120 months;
  • § 6 odst. 3 písm. c): goodwill is written off evenly within 60 months at the latest;
  • § 56 odst. 11: land, works of art and collections, emission allowances and preferential limits are not depreciated.

The useful lives in these profiles are therefore defaults for your depreciation plan, not statutory values. Review them against your internal policy (vnitřní směrnice) before the first asset is confirmed.

The profiles

Each profile posts depreciation to 551000 (Odpisy dlouhodobého nehmotného a hmotného majetku) in the miscellaneous operations journal, straight-line, one entry per month:

Profile (name as shown) Asset account Accumulated depreciation Years
Nehmotné výsledky vývoje 012000 072000 5
Software 013000 073000 3
Ostatní ocenitelná práva 014000 074000 6
Goodwill 015000 075000 5
Ostatní dlouhodobý nehmotný majetek 019000 079000 5
Stavby 021000 081000 30
Hmotné movité věci a jejich soubory 022000 082000 5
Pěstitelské celky trvalých porostů 025000 085000 10
Dospělá zvířata a jejich skupiny 026000 086000 5
Jiný dlouhodobý hmotný majetek 029000 089000 5

Profile settings: Computation Method Linear, Time Method Number of Years or end date, Period Length Month, Prorata Temporis on. The first year therefore gets only its share of the annual depreciation, from the asset's depreciation start date to the year end — OCA counts that share in days — and not a whole year's charge for an asset put into use in November. That matters twice for intangible assets (012–019) acquired from 2021: the Income Tax Act no longer has tax depreciation of intangibles, so their accounting depreciation is what reaches the tax base. Set the start date to the first day of the month your plan starts depreciating in (the month of putting into use, or the month after) to get whole months.

No profile is created for:

  • 031 Pozemky, 032 Umělecká díla a sbírky, 016 Povolenky na emise and 017 Preferenční limity: nothing on them is depreciated, and a profile would assert a useful life they do not have;
  • 027 Oceňovací rozdíl k nabytému majetku: it is depreciated (evenly over 180 months, § 7 odst. 10 of the vyhláška), but it arises only when a business is acquired and posts to 557, not 551. Create its profile by hand when you need it.

No profile has a tax depreciation group. Track Tax Depreciation is off and Tax Depreciation Group is empty on every one, deliberately: the account does not decide the group — a building may be group 4, 5 or 6, a movable thing 1, 2 or 3 — and a wrong default would quietly produce wrong tax depreciation.

Setting it up

The profiles are created for every company using the Czech chart of accounts: when the chart is loaded, and on installation for companies that already had it. A profile the company already has is never recreated or overwritten, so your edits survive later upgrades. A company that has deleted or renumbered one of the accounts the profiles use is skipped (the server log records a warning) and has to create its profiles by hand.

After installation, in Invoicing → Configuration → Assets → Asset Profiles:

  1. Adjust the useful lives to your depreciation plan. Change Period Length to Year if you post depreciation once a year; keep Prorata Temporis on unless your plan really charges a whole year in the first year.
  2. For profiles whose assets all fall into one depreciation group, tick Track Tax Depreciation and pick the Tax Depreciation Group. Assets created from the profile afterwards take the group with them (see account_asset_tax). Otherwise leave it empty and set the group on each asset.
  3. Create further profiles where one account holds assets with very different useful lives (for example several profiles on 022000).

Limitations

  • The useful lives are defaults, not law, and the same for every company. They do not depend on the tax depreciation group.
  • OCA pro-rates the first year by days from the depreciation start date, not by whole months: a start on 1 July gives 184/365 of the annual amount, not 6/12. Start on the first of a month and the difference is a few days' worth.
  • Existing assets are not touched. Changing a profile later does not change assets already created from it.
  • Community asset register only: the module requires account_asset_tax_oca and so cannot be installed alongside Odoo Enterprise's account_asset.

  • Vyhláška č. 500/2002 Sb., kterou se provádějí některá ustanovení zákona č. 563/1991 Sb., o účetnictví, ve znění pozdějších předpisů, pro účetní jednotky, které jsou podnikateli účtujícími v soustavě podvojného účetnictví
